Bauplan zum gewählten Schwerpunkt: welch: Build plan for the chosen focus: which goods are scarce for it in the home market (price above base price) and what to build next. “Compared with” names the markets used to compare prices.
Deine Beziehungen zu anderen Ländern. Di: Your relations with other countries. The number is that country's opinion of us (−200 to +200). Great Power = one of the most powerful countries in the world according to the game. Diplomats and Diplomatic Capacity: now / maximum.
Deine Güterbilanz: was deine Orte förder: Your goods balance: what your locations extract and your buildings produce, against what your buildings consume (nominal values per month). × values = price in the home market divided by the base price: ×1.00 is normal, below is cheap, above is expensive.
Deine Kasse wie im Wirtschaftsfenster, B: Your treasury as in the economy window, amounts in gold per month. Brackets = change from last month: green better, red worse. Inflation and debt turn red as soon as they are above 0.
Deine Streitkräfte wie im Militärfenster: Your forces as in the military window. Levies and regulars in men: raised / possible. 0 means none are raised right now; levies can only be raised in war or against rebels. Manpower and sailors in thousands, now / maximum. Fort limit: used / limit.
EU5 Ratgeber: die Kacheln des Ratgebers: EU5 Ratgeber: the advisor tiles – Advisor, Economy, State, Foreign & Military (data mod). Opening reloads the texts.
Eckdaten deines Landes. Bevölkerung in T: Key figures of your country. Population in thousands; capacity = how many people your locations can support. Primary culture and state religion = share of the population.
Herrscher (Verwaltung / Diplomatie / Mil: Ruler (administrative / diplomatic / military, age), cabinet with the progress of its actions, Political Influence, number of laws and reforms.
Je Stand direkt aus dem Spiel: Balken =: Per estate straight from the game: bar = satisfaction, power = share of power in the country, Satisfaction Equilibrium = the value satisfaction moves towards.
Krankheiten: oben unser Land (live), die: Diseases: our country at the top (live), the table shows the world's outbreaks according to the save. Disease Resistance = the country's modifier, affected own locations = locations with spread above 0.
Laufende Forschung und Tempo. Institutio: Current research and its pace. Institutions: embraced = accepted by us, spawned = present in the world but not yet here.
Lohnt ein Krieg? Oben unsere Stärke, unt: Is a war worth it? Our strength at the top, the advisor's rating per country below. Strength us : them above 1 means we are stronger.
Lädt die Texte des Ratgebers neu (Konsol: Reloads the advisor texts (console command switchlanguage, the game stutters briefly).
Länder, die du gründen könntest. Orte un: Countries you could form. Locations and conditions show what is still missing. Our tier = our country's rank among formations; game rule = the “Formable Countries” setting.
Noch keine Daten. Das Programm EU5 Ratge: No data yet. The EU5 Ratgeber program must be running and needs a save (launch option -force_text_save). Then press “Refresh”.
Prüfung Spiel und Daten-Mod: Check of game and data mod
Religion, Kultur und Kunst laut Spiel. T: Religion, culture and art according to the game. Tolerance: own faith / heretics / heathens. Cultural Tradition and Cultural Influence apply to your primary culture, brackets = change per month. Accepted Cultures: used / capacity.

Schwerpunkt wählen – wie im Wirtschaftsp: Choose a focus, as in the advisor's economy plan (applies to the Advisor tab)
Spielwert – live aus dem Spiel, ohne Rec: Game value, live from the game, not calculated by the advisor
Spielwerte live aus dem Spiel wie im Stä: Game values live as in the estates window: satisfaction (bar), power, Satisfaction Equilibrium
Steuergrundlage deiner Orte. „Möglich“ i: Tax Base of your locations. “Possible” is the value at full control; the difference is lost to low control. Proximity and Market Access are averages over all locations. Building Maintenance = country buildings in all locations, gold per month.
Was dein Land am Handel verdient. Gewinn: What your country earns from trade. Route profit = what your merchants earn; trade income = the part of it for the treasury. Merchant capacity: what your merchants can move, the used part in brackets.
Was deine Gebäude im Monat abwerfen (Gew: What your buildings earn per month (profit according to the game, live). Best and weakest type: all buildings of a kind added up.
Was der Ratgeber jetzt vorschlägt, Wicht: What the advisor suggests now, most important first (high, medium, low). Within a level, what fits the chosen focus comes first. The reasons are in the tooltip, a click opens the matching window.
Welche Einstellungen zum gewählten Schwe: Which settings fit the chosen focus. Deviations = how many of your settings differ from the suggestion. First steps and the table now/suggested are further down.
Öffnet die Seite des Ratgebers im Browse: Opens the advisor page in the browser (the advisor must be running; it reads the click from debug.log). In fullscreen, switch to the browser with Alt+Tab.
